### Necessary Notes
- Only supports vehicle configuration via device-specific protocols;
- Close and exit the client before replacing the file;

### Replacement Method
1. Click to download the library file to be replaced, libconfig_18.dll, and extract it. Click here to download [libconfig_18-2026-05-25(1).zip](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0181095e6075cc32d6c4104d1dfe67f3 "[libconfig_18-2026-05-25(1).zip")
2. Open the installation path of the CMSV6 client. The default installation location is C:\Program Files. Replace these five files in (x86)\CMSV6\plugin\config\libconfig_18
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=fe912ffb1bf314d491698f032bb06b21)
3. Click the "language" folder and replace these two files
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=500b78c033e817afb9550b5be99cc7f5)
4. Reopen the client, click on parameter configuration to open the configuration plugin and configure various parameters.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d214d18c88e8b286c91cea173c5ad191)
For detailed usage instructions, please refer to: [Tongtianxing Client Plugin Online Configuration Tool](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/web/#/13/104 "Tongtianxing Client Plugin Online Configuration Tool")
